Hyperliquid Surpassed Bybit, Kraken and OKX in Open Interest in Q3

According to a Q3 report by independent research group Hyperliquid Research Collective (HRC), Hyperliquid surpassed Bybit, Kraken and OKX in open interest (OI) during the third quarter. Its OI reached approximately $16.8 billion by the end of September, up nearly 80% from the end of June, and hit an all-time high of $18.1 billion on September 22.
